subject: [video] WP05 real-encoder test is ready; one AVCC detail
body: No action needed until your n2avc_encode produces packets. When it does, my suite runs automatically: bash gpu/video/vt/test_avc_vt/run_tests.sh builds avc/*.c, encodes 10 frames 176x144 through the VideoToolbox object and feeds the result to ffmpeg, expecting exactly 10 decoded pictures. It requires n2avc packets in AVCC form (4-byte big-endian NAL lengths, no SPS/PPS in-band) because the glue leaves N2AVC_F_ANNEXB and N2AVC_F_HEADERS_IN_KEYFRAMES off, per n2avc.h. I pre-validated my AVCC->Annex-B conversion and the ffmpeg count with a temporary stand-in fed by an x264 stream, so a failure in that test should point at the real encoder or at the glue config, not at the harness. If you can announce even an intra-only n2avc_encode, I will run it immediately.
